# What this document is

The **refined, parameterised** version of [test8.qmd](../ane_originals/test8.qmd). Same physics,
zero copy-paste — every step is a function call into the orchestration
module at [lib/sweep_runner.py](../lib/sweep_runner.py).

This is the *unit cell* of every stage of the configuration-space sweep
([SWEEP_PLAN.md](../design/SWEEP_PLAN.md)). A stage qmd loops `run_one_config`
over its parameter grid; this document runs it exactly once and shows the
result.

> **Why we have both this and test8.qmd.** test8.qmd is the verbatim
> reproduction of Ane's notebook — kept as the historical reference, with all
> the inline boilerplate. This file imports the same physics from
> sweep_runner and is what every future driver builds on.

# 1. Imports and configuration

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

# Make the sweep package importable regardless of where Quarto runs us from
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "lib"))

import sweep_runner as sr
from plot_helpers import plot_sim_vs_exp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ── The single configuration to evaluate ────────────────────────────
cfg = sr.SimConfig(
    period_um        = 12.9,                   # grating period (µm)
    A_um             = 1.5,                    # half-amplitude (depth = 2A = 3.0 µm)
    t_oxide_um       = 0.9,                    # Cr₂O₃ overlayer thickness (µm)
    oxide_dispersion = "HS_caliente",          # {"HS_caliente", "RS_frio"}
    theta_deg        = 30.0,                   # incidence polar angle
    phi_sim_deg      = 89.0,                   # rcwa azimuth (≡ φ_exp = 0° per Ane)
    harmonics        = 35,                     # NA — fix once Stage 0a converges
    slices           = 50,
    beta_deg         = 2.0,                    # detector aperture cone (full)
    wavelengths_um   = np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25),
)

# ── The experimental triple this configuration is being scored against ───
SAMPLE        = "12-3"
THETA_EXP_DEG = 30
PHI_EXP_DEG   = 0

# ── Output location ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
OUT = Path.cwd() / "exploratory/runs/adhoc"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

print("Configuration to evaluate:")
for k, v in cfg.__dict__.items():
    if k != "wavelengths_um":
        print(f"  {k:<18s} = {v}")
print(f"  wavelengths_um   = {cfg.wavelengths_um.min()}–{cfg.wavelengths_um.max()} µm "
      f"({len(cfg.wavelengths_um)} pts)")
print(f"  filename_stem    = {cfg.filename_stem()}")
print()
print(f"Scoring against: sample={SAMPLE}, θ={THETA_EXP_DEG}°, φ_exp={PHI_EXP_DEG}°")
```

# 2. Solve and score

```{python}
#| label: run

t0 = time.time()
result = sr.run_one_config(
    cfg            = cfg,
    sample         = SAMPLE,
    theta_exp_deg  = THETA_EXP_DEG,
    phi_exp_deg    = PHI_EXP_DEG,
    output_dir     = OUT,
)
print(f"\nDone in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")
print()
print("Metrics (smaller is better, except pearson_r):")
print(f"  N (overlap)         = {result['n_overlap']}")
print(f"  χ²_red(R_total)     = {result['R_chi2_red']:7.2f}")
print(f"  χ²_red(R_det β=2°)  = {result['Rdet_chi2_red']:7.2f}")
print(f"  RMSE(R_det)         = {result['Rdet_RMSE']:.4f}")
print(f"  MAE(R_det)          = {result['Rdet_MAE']:.4f}")
print(f"  max|res|(R_det)     = {result['Rdet_max_abs']:.4f}")
print(f"  Pearson r(R_det)    = {result['Rdet_pearson_r']:.4f}")
print(f"  ⟨R_exp - R_sim⟩     = (mean over overlap)")
print(f"  output csv          = {result['sim_csv']}")
```

# 3. Plot — simulation vs experiment

```{python}
#| label: plot

stem = cfg.filename_stem()
exp_files = sorted(
    (Path.cwd().parent / "data" / "experimental").glob(
        f"{SAMPLE}_{THETA_EXP_DEG}_{int(PHI_EXP_DEG) if PHI_EXP_DEG == int(PHI_EXP_DEG) else PHI_EXP_DEG}_*.CSV"
    )
)

fig, ax = plot_sim_vs_exp(
    sim_lx_path   = OUT / f"LX_{stem}.csv",
    sim_ly_path   = OUT / f"LY_{stem}.csv",
    sim_avg_path  = OUT / f"AVG_{stem}.csv",
    exp_paths     = exp_files,
    sample_label  = SAMPLE,                   # gets escaped to SS\_12\_3 by the helper
    theta_exp_deg = THETA_EXP_DEG,
    phi_exp_deg   = PHI_EXP_DEG,
    beta_deg      = cfg.beta_deg,
    figsize       = (7.5, 6.5),
)
plt.show()
```

# 4. Anatomy — why this is the right unit cell

Each cell of the configuration-space sweep is exactly the call above:

```python
result = run_one_config(cfg, sample, theta_exp_deg, phi_exp_deg, output_dir)
# returns a dict ready to append to a sweep CSV row
```

A stage qmd is then nothing but

```python
rows = []
for params in stage_grid:
    cfg = sr.SimConfig(**params)
    rows.append(sr.run_one_config(cfg, sample, theta_exp_deg, phi_exp_deg, OUT))
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv("stageX_results.csv", index=False)
```

Compare with the original [test8.qmd](../ane_originals/test8.qmd) §5 which inlines `datos_cromo`,
`discretize_rugosity_with_oxide`, the wavelength loop, the polarisation loop,
the per-pol CSV save, the average, and the plot — all in one cell, ~150 lines.
The decoupling we just shipped:

| Concern | Lives in | Tested in |
|---|---|---|
| Material splines (SS, Cr₂O₃) | `sweep_runner.ss_splines`, `sweep_runner.oxide_splines` | smoke test on import |
| Geometry generator | `sweep_runner.sinusoidal_profile` | shape-checked |
| Layer discretisation | `sweep_runner.discretize_with_oxide` | byte-equivalent to Ane's function |
| RCWA solve (one config, both pols) | `sweep_runner.solve_one` | this document |
| Polarisation average | `sweep_runner.average_polarisations` | this document |
| Experimental loader | `sweep_runner.load_experimental_repeats` | covered by `score` |
| Distance metric | `sweep_runner.score` | matches compare.qmd's standalone calc |
| End-to-end orchestration | `sweep_runner.run_one_config` | this document |
| Comparison plot | `plot_helpers.plot_sim_vs_exp` | this document, [test8_plot.qmd](test8_plot.qmd) |

> Every subsequent stage qmd (Stage 0a NA convergence, Stage 1 Tier-1 sweep,
> Stage 2 Tier-2 geometry sweep) imports the same two modules and never
> reimplements any of the above.
